channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Nuclear Briefcase Seen at APEC Summit
item.description: A military officer was observed carrying what is described as a 'nuclear briefcase' at the APEC summit. The nature and function of this briefcase were highlighted in reports. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Myanmar Leader Reconsidering ASEAN Ties Amid Crisis
item.description: Myanmar's army-backed leader, Min Aung Hlaing, has stated that his administration is reconsidering its ties with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN). The announcement comes amid the ongoing crisis in Myanmar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Iran's Army Chief Warns of Stronger Response to US Attacks
item.description: Iran's army chief has vowed a "more crushing" response should the United States launch further attacks. This statement comes amid reports suggesting Iran's military leaders are poised to assume greater authority within the country. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rep. Mullin Defends Use of Government Plane for College Football Game
item.description: Representative Mullin has defended his use of a government plane to travel to a college football game. This defense comes after a ground stop occurred. Mullin stated he was defending his trip to the game. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford Apologizes for French Language Skills
item.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has apologized for his performance speaking French during a recent visit to Montreal. Ford acknowledged that his French "needs work" and described his attempt as "botched." He stated that his effort was a "show of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Democrats Nominate Hakeem Jeffries for House Speaker, Making History
item.description: Democrats have nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be Speaker of the House, a move that could make him the first Black person to hold the position. The nomination by House Democrats positions Jeffries to potentially make history. Some Democrats… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump gestures to Xi Jinping on escalator
item.description: During an event, Donald Trump appeared to gesture towards Xi Jinping as they were on an escalator, with Trump saying "take my hand." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Denmark Approves Greenland Security Deal with US
item.description: Danish lawmakers have unanimously ratified a security agreement between Denmark, Greenland, and the United States. The deal comes after months of Arctic tensions. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Elon Musk Regrets Republican Campaign Spending, Distances Himself from MAGA
item.description: Elon Musk stated he feels "pretty foolish" for spending over $400 million to back Republican candidates, admitting the political investment did not yield the expected results following the US midterm elections. He also distanced himself… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala Govt Cancels Scholarship Exam Amidst Allegations of Political Pressure
item.description: The Kerala Congress government has withdrawn its approval for the Balagokulam's Mayilpeeli Young Scholar Examination, a scholarship test for students in Classes 5 to 10. The exam offered scholarships worth Rs 1 lakh. Initial permission was… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Bengaluru Police Restructured Under New Chief Commissioner
item.description: Bengaluru police have been restructured into five commissionerates, operating under a Chief Commissioner. R Hithendra has been appointed as the Bengaluru City Police Chief. This change is part of a major IPS reshuffle in Karnataka. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: UP extends term of Gram Adhikaris by 6 months
item.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has extended the tenure of Gram Adhikaris (village administrators) by six months. This decision comes as the government awaits a report from the Backward Classes Commission. The extension is intended to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi Claims Election Commission Leaks Information
item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi claimed that information is being leaked from within the Election Commission, stating that "this structure will not last much longer." He also asserted that Indian democracy is "sacred" and that boycotting… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Malaysia Ends Visa-Free Entry for Indian Citizens
item.description: Malaysia will end its visa-free entry policy for Indian citizens starting January 1, 2027. Travelers planning trips to Malaysia after this date will need to check the new entry requirements and obtain the necessary visas. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi Rules Out Congress Election Boycott
item.description: Rahul Gandhi has stated that the Congress party will not boycott elections, despite alleging "vote chori" (vote theft). He indicated that the opposition would face challenges until the public recognizes flaws in the electoral process… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: PM Modi, others pay tribute to Indira Gandhi on birth anniversary
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, along with other leaders, paid tribute to former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi on her 109th birth anniversary. The event marked the remembrance of the 'Iron Lady' of India. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: India Changes PUC Norms for BS-VI Vehicles, Offers Relief
item.description: The Indian government has revised rules for Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificates, providing relief to owners of BS-VI vehicles. These vehicles will now receive a three-year validity for their PUC certificates. For BS-IV and older… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: TVK MLA V S Babu, who defeated MK Stalin, dies at 75
item.description: V S Babu, a two-time MLA from the Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC) representing Kolathur, has died in Chennai at the age of 75 after a prolonged illness. Babu had previously defeated current Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M K Stalin in the 2006… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: UP Election: Parties React to Candidate Lists and Yogi Adityanath
item.description: Ahead of Uttar Pradesh elections, a list of BJP candidates has caused controversy. Separately, Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav led a 20km Rath Yatra in Gorakhpur. Chandra Shekhar Aazad of Nagina MP welcomed potential allies for a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Seeks ₹9,618 Crore for Maritime Projects
item.description: The Tamil Nadu government has requested ₹9,618 crore from the central government for maritime infrastructure projects. These projects include a potential ferry service between Rameswaram and Sri Lanka and the revival of the Buckingham… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: BJP Accuses Rahul Gandhi of Defaming India Abroad
item.description: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leaders have accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi of insulting and defaming India while speaking abroad. BJP leader Gaurav Bhatia called Gandhi "Mir Jafar of India" and alleged he was trying to tarnish the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 10 · Right 5.

item.title: Leaders Meet at APEC Summit in Shenzhen
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping met on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Wednesday, November 18. The leaders and their delegations had lunch together. Xi Jinping urged closer political and… Coverage: Left 9 · Centre 34 · Right 7.

item.title: UK's Burnham Criticizes Brexit Ahead of EU Summit
item.description: Andy Burnham, the Mayor of Greater Manchester, stated that Brexit has not worked and that the isolation it has caused is what "our enemies want." He made these remarks ahead of a summit aimed at resetting relations with the European Union… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: EU Nations Revive Rwanda Migrant Deportation Plans
item.description: Five European Union nations are reviving plans to deport rejected migrants to Rwanda. The scheme, which has been debated by Members of the European Parliament (MEPs), is seen by some in Europe as an ideal destination for such individuals… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Omar Abdullah Questions Centre on J&K Statehood Delay
item.description: Omar Abdullah, identified as Chief Minister, has challenged the Centre to clarify the delay in restoring statehood to Jammu and Kashmir. He stated that the people should not be humiliated and that previous assurances of statehood at an… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: White House Withdraws FDA Nominee Heidi Overton Amid Republican Concerns
item.description: The White House has withdrawn the nomination of Heidi Overton to be the F.D.A. Commissioner. Republicans had raised concerns regarding her nomination, leading to the withdrawal. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Mississauga Data Centre Moratorium Faces Legal Challenges
item.description: Mississauga's one-year moratorium on data centre construction is facing a second legal challenge at the Ontario Land Tribunal, brought by a Toronto-based real estate investment firm. Separately, Calgary is set to hold public hearings… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: UEFA backs Diallo to challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency
item.description: UEFA has endorsed France's candidate, Diallo, to run against Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency. The election is scheduled to take place at the FIFA Congress on March 18 of the following year. UEFA had reportedly been seeking a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump's Manila Visit Includes Jollibee Meal and Meeting with Marcos Family
item.description: During a visit to Manila, US President Donald Trump was treated to a meal of Jollibee fried chicken by Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Marcos Jr. mentioned to Trump that he had asked his mother, Imelda Marcos, to greet the US… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Ghana's Presidential Jet Purchase Sparks Public Outrage Over Cost
item.description: Ghana has acquired a new presidential jet, a Falcon 6X, costing $60 million, to replace its older aircraft. The purchase has ignited public anger due to its significant expense, particularly as many Ghanaians are contending with the rising… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: DealBook Summit Features Tech Leaders, Politicians, and Business Figures
item.description: The DealBook Summit is scheduled to feature prominent speakers including JD Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, Zohran Mamdani, Satya Nadella, and Hailey Bieber. The event is set to take place today, with… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: French Troops Reportedly Inside Ukraine; Ex-NATO Chief Praises Macron
item.description: Reports indicate a secret deployment of French troops inside Ukraine, a move praised by a former NATO chief who commended French President Macron's "guts." The former NATO chief stated that French troops in Ukraine "wouldn't be a surprise." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Commentary Compares Potential Trump-Xi-Putin Summit to Yalta
item.description: Commentary in several outlets draws parallels between a potential summit involving Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin, and the Yalta Conference of 1945. Some analyses suggest the current situation risks repeating the mistakes of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Telangana CM to Launch Family Insurance Scheme on November 19
item.description: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy is set to launch a family insurance scheme on November 19. The launch event will take place in Siddipet. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: UPSC CSE 2026 Interview Schedule Announced for 2,526 Candidates
item.description: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the interview schedule for the Civil Services Examination (CSE) 2026. A total of 2,526 candidates are slated to appear for their interviews, which are set to commence on December 7. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: ECI allows voters to re-enroll if name was deleted for not filling SIR form
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has provided an opportunity for voters whose names were deleted from the electoral roll for not filling the 'SIR' form to get their names re-enrolled. Special camps were organized in areas like… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Shiv Sena demands removal of Savarkar passages from book, targets Sonia Gandhi
item.description: The Shiv Sena has demanded the removal of certain passages from the book 'Belonging', alleging that Sonia Gandhi has insulted the memory of Veer Savarkar. The party has called for a ban on the book in Maharashtra. The specific passages and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Federal Reserve Governor Cook Declines White House Hearing
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook has declined to participate in a White House hearing, with her lawyer stating the event would be "unfair." The specific reasons for her refusal and the nature of the hearing were not detailed in the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Israeli Parliament Elects Opposition-Backed Speaker
item.description: Israel's parliament, the Knesset, has elected Matan Kahana, an ally of Benny Gantz's National Unity party, as its new speaker. Kahana secured the position with support from the opposition bloc. This development is seen as a significant… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: Netanyahu Accused of Electoral Interference Amidst Israeli Election
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu has been accused of electoral interference in Israel. The country is holding elections in 2026, with a race to build a government involving figures like Eisenkot and Netanyahu. The specific nature of the electoral… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
